verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no training opt-out or data-usage control for replica-skill. The only privacy-adjacent item says its helper Python scripts do not touch the network. That describes local processing, not a way to stop data from being used to train AI models, and any training policy would belong to the host LLM platform rather than this skill pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
